pages.name: System Requirements
pages.markdown:
# System Requirements

## Minimum Requirements

- CPU: 2+ cores
- RAM: 4GB
- Disk: 20GB free space

## Recommended

- CPU: 4+ cores
- RAM: 8GB
- Disk: 50GB free space

pages.name: Software Dependencies
pages.markdown:
# Software Dependencies

## Required Software

- PHP 8.1+
- MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.2+
- Composer
- Git

## Optional

- Redis (for caching)
- LDAP server (for authentication)
